dek: Chinese war comedy Once Upon a Time in the Middle East has grossed more than 1 billion yuan (US$148 million) in its first week, bucking a broader slump in domestic box-office sales and sluggish consumer spending. Officially released last Tuesday, the film follows a Chinese cook struggling to survive after being caught
